程序包 org.bukkit.inventory.meta

接口 PotionMeta

所有超级接口:
Cloneable, ConfigurationSerializable, ItemMeta
public interface PotionMeta extends ItemMeta
Represents a potion (Material.POTION) that can have custom effects. 表示一瓶可以拥有自定义效果的药水（Material.POTION）。

  • 方法详细资料

    • hasCustomEffects

      boolean hasCustomEffects()
      Checks for the presence of custom potion effects. 检查是否存在自定义药水效果。
      返回:
      true if custom potion effects are applied 若应用了自定义药水效果则为 true

    • getCustomEffects

      List<PotionEffect> getCustomEffects()
      Gets an immutable list containing all custom potion effects applied to this potion. 获取一个包含应用于此药水的所有自定义药水效果的不可变列表。

      Plugins should check that hasCustomEffects() returns true before calling this method. 插件在调用此方法前应检查 hasCustomEffects() 是否返回 true。

      返回:
      the immutable list of custom potion effects 自定义药水效果的不可变列表

    • addCustomEffect

      boolean addCustomEffect(PotionEffect effect, boolean overwrite)
      Adds a custom potion effect to this potion. 为此药水添加一个自定义药水效果。
      参数:
      effect - the potion effect to add 要添加的药水效果
      overwrite - true if any existing effect of the same type should be 若应覆盖同类型的现有效果则为 true overwritten
      返回:
      true if the potion meta changed as a result of this call 若此调用改变了药水元数据则为 true

    • removeCustomEffect

      boolean removeCustomEffect(PotionEffectType type)
      Removes a custom potion effect from this potion. 从此药水移除一个自定义药水效果。
      参数:
      type - the potion effect type to remove 要移除的药水效果类型
      返回:
      true if the potion meta changed as a result of this call 若此调用改变了药水元数据则为 true

    • hasCustomEffect

      boolean hasCustomEffect(PotionEffectType type)
      Checks for a specific custom potion effect type on this potion. 检查此药水上是否存在特定的自定义药水效果类型。
      参数:
      type - the potion effect type to check for 要检查的药水效果类型
      返回:
      true if the potion has this effect 若该药水拥有此效果则为 true

    • setMainEffect

      boolean setMainEffect(PotionEffectType type)
      Moves a potion effect to the top of the potion effect list. 将一个药水效果移动到药水效果列表的顶部。

      This causes the client to display the potion effect in the potion's name. 这会使客户端在药水名称中显示该药水效果。

      参数:
      type - the potion effect type to move 要移动的药水效果类型
      返回:
      true if the potion meta changed as a result of this call 若此调用改变了药水元数据则为 true

    • clearCustomEffects

      boolean clearCustomEffects()
      Removes all custom potion effects from this potion. 移除此药水的所有自定义药水效果。
      返回:
      true if the potion meta changed as a result of this call 若此调用改变了药水元数据则为 true
